packet.headline_seed: Artan to referee Uefa Super Cup after losing World Cup role
packet.description_seed: Somali referee Omar Artan is appointed to take charge of the Uefa Super Cup match between Paris St-Germain and Aston Villa later this summer after being denied a spot at the World Cup.

what: Artan to referee Uefa Super Cup after losing World Cup role

clean_source_blocks.text: Somali referee Omar Artan is appointed to take charge of the Uefa Super Cup match between Paris St-Germain and Aston Villa later this summer after being denied a spot at the World Cup.

Omar Artan became a Fifa-listed referee in 2018 Somali referee Omar Artan, who was denied entry to the United States to officiate at the World Cup, has been appointed to take charge of the Uefa Super Cup match between Paris St-Germain and Aston Villa. The contest between Champions League winners PSG and Aston Villa, who triumphed in the Europa League, is scheduled to take place on 12 August in Salzburg. European football's governing body said the decision had been taken after discussions with the Confederation of African Football (Caf). Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin said: "Omar Artan is an excellent young but already experienced referee, who has proven himself at the highest competition level of the Confederation of African Football.

UEFA’s official X account posted on Thursday, June 11, that Somali referee Omar Artan will officiate the 2026 UEFA Super Cup between PSG and Aston Villa in Salzburg. The post follows reports that Artan was denied entry into the United States before the 2026 World Cup. The appointment places Artan on another major international fixture after a difficult period away from the pitch. UEFA’s official X account posted: “Referee announced for 2026 #SuperCup!” The same post said Somali referee Omar Artan will officiate the match between PSG and Aston Villa in Salzburg. PSG and Aston Villa are due to meet in the Super Cup, with the match scheduled to take place in Austria. The UEFA post is the available public source for Artan’s appointment at this stage. Artan was denied entry into the United States before the 2026 World Cup.

The case was also covered in the United States, where reports said a World Cup referee had been denied entry. Further background identified Somali referee Omar Artan as the official involved. Artan’s Super Cup appointment now gives him a major European fixture after the World Cup entry issue. The final will bring together PSG and Aston Villa in Salzburg, with Artan named by UEFA’s X account as the match referee. original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Omar Artan became a Fifa-listed referee in 2018

Somali referee Omar Artan, who was denied entry to the United States to officiate at the World Cup, has been appointed to take charge of the Uefa Super Cup match between Paris St-Germain and Aston Villa.

The contest between Champions League winners PSG and Aston Villa, who triumphed in the Europa League, is scheduled to take place on 12 August in Salzburg.

European football's governing body said the decision had been taken after discussions with the Confederation of African Football (Caf).

Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin said: "Omar Artan is an excellent young but already experienced referee, who has proven himself at the highest competition level of the Confederation of African Football.

"Football is made to connect people, and Uefa wants to show its respect to Omar and his outstanding officiating skills, which had earned him such a prestigious nomination.

"I am grateful to my friend Caf president Patrice Motsepe for supporting enthusiastically our initiative."

Artan, the 2025 Caf men's referee of the year, who has been on Fifa's international list since 2018, was set to be the first Somali to referee at the World Cup finals.

However, he was turned away by border officials in Miami despite holding a diplomatic passport and a single-entry US visa.

On Wednesday, a US government official said Artan had not been allowed to enter the country because of an alleged "association with suspected members of terror organisations".

Somalia is one of several countries on a travel ban list introduced by US President Donald Trump. After speaking to the US authorities, world governing body Fifa said Artan would miss the tournament.

Artan told the New York Times this week that he was questioned by border officials over his links to Somali militant group Al Shabab and had told them he knew nothing about the group.

"I had the right papers and everything. I had the right visa," said Artan.

"I'm just simply a referee who's trying to live his dream, the biggest dream of my life, to come to the World Cup."

[Lähde: FOX Sports]
In a surprising turn of events, UEFA has confirmed that Artan will take charge of the season-opening showpiece between Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa on August 12. The match, held in Salzburg, marks a significant moment for African officiating, with Artan becoming the first referee from the continent to lead a major UEFA final.

The appointment comes just days after Artan was forced to return to Somalia. He had arrived in Miami to join the World Cup match officials' base but was blocked by U.S. Border and Customs Protection. A statement from the authorities cited "vetting concerns" for his removal, a decision that has sparked widespread debate across the football world.

payload.title: Omar Artan tuomariksi Uefan Super Cupiin MM-takaiskun jälkeen
payload.summary: Somalialainen erotuomari Omar Artan on nimetty viheltämään Uefan Super Cupin ottelu PSG:n ja Aston Villan välillä Salzburgissa 12. elokuuta.
payload.content:
Somalialainen erotuomari Omar Artan on saanut merkittävän kansainvälisen tehtävän sen jälkeen, kun hänen MM-roolinsa jäi toteutumatta Yhdysvaltoihin pääsyn estymisen vuoksi. Artan on nimetty Uefan Super Cupin päätuomariksi otteluun, jossa Paris Saint-Germain ja Aston Villa kohtaavat Salzburgissa 12. elokuuta.

## Super Cup pelataan Salzburgissa

Uefan Super Cup kokoaa vastakkain Euroopan seurajalkapallon kaksi tuoretta eurokilpailujen voittajaa. Tällä kertaa ottelussa kohtaavat Mestarien liigan voittanut Paris Saint-Germain ja Eurooppa-liigan voittanut Aston Villa.

Ottelu on määrä pelata Itävallassa Salzburgissa. Uefan virallinen X-tili kertoi torstaina 11. kesäkuuta, että Artan tuomitsee vuoden 2026 Super Cupin. Sama viesti nimesi somalialaistuomarin PSG:n ja Aston Villan välisen ottelun erotuomariksi.

## Päätös tehtiin Cafin kanssa

Artanista tuli Fifan kansainvälisellä listalla oleva erotuomari vuonna 2018. Uefan mukaan päätös hänen nimeämisestään tehtiin keskustelujen jälkeen Afrikan jalkapalloliiton Cafin kanssa.

Uefan puheenjohtaja Aleksander Ceferin kuvaili Artania erinomaiseksi nuoreksi mutta jo kokeneeksi erotuomariksi. Ceferinin mukaan Artan on osoittanut tasonsa Afrikan jalkapalloliiton korkeimmissa kilpailuissa.

## Nimitys seuraa MM-kisojen takaiskua

Artanin tapaus nousi esiin sen jälkeen, kun hänen kerrottiin jääneen pois MM-tehtävästä, koska häneltä evättiin pääsy Yhdysvaltoihin. Yhdysvalloissa julkaistuissa tiedoissa kerrottiin MM-erotuomarista, jolta oli evätty maahantulo, ja myöhempi taustoitus yhdisti tapauksen Artaniin.

Super Cup -nimitys antaa Artanille uuden suuren kansainvälisen ottelun vaikean jakson jälkeen. Lähteiden mukaan PSG:n ja Aston Villan kohtaaminen Salzburgissa on tässä vaiheessa julkisesti vahvistettu Uefan omassa viestintäkanavassa, ja sama tieto nimeää Artanin ottelun päätuomariksi.
summary_bullets: Omar Artan on nimetty Uefan Super Cupin päätuomariksi.
PSG ja Aston Villa kohtaavat Salzburgissa 12. elokuuta.
Nimitys seuraa tapausta, jossa Artanilta evättiin pääsy Yhdysvaltoihin ennen MM-kisoja.
